packageRules.description: Same policy as the homelab repository: patch and minor automerge, majors wait for a human. No groups -- every workload gets its own PR.
Three days between a release and its PR, as in the homelab repository: long enough for an upstream to pull a broken or compromised tag. Renovate lifts this for its own vulnerability-alert PRs.

A PostgreSQL major version is an offline migration that takes the workload down while it runs, and it is not reversible. It waits for a human even though the image tag makes it look like any other bump. See cloudnative-pg.md in the homelab docs.

A minor bump of the Nextcloud chart carries a major bump of Nextcloud itself -- 9.1 shipped 33, 9.2 shipped 34 -- and Nextcloud refuses to upgrade across more than one major at a time. So chart minors wait for a human.

One PR per Nextcloud chart minor, so 9.3 to 9.5 is visibly two steps to merge in order rather than one merge that crash-loops the pod on 'Updates between multiple major versions ... are unsupported'. Renovate does not allow this key alongside matchUpdateTypes, hence the separate rule.

Home Assistant versions its releases as calendar dates, which semver reads as a major bump every month. Without this every routine release would wait for a human and none of them would ever be automerged.

customManagers.description: Webfont releases vendored into docs/assets/fonts by scripts/update-fonts.sh. Renovate moves the pins in that script; the woff2 files are binaries it cannot write, so run `make fonts` on the branch it opens and commit the result -- `make fonts-check` fails the PR otherwise.

CloudNativePG names its operand image in `imageName`, which holds a complete image reference rather than a bare tag, so neither the kubernetes manager nor a tag-shaped comment manager reads it. `autoReplaceStringTemplate` is what lets `config:best-practices` write the digest: a custom manager rewrites the matched string verbatim, so without a template naming `newDigest` the pin has nowhere to go and fails the whole shared pin branch. `imageName: ` is part of the match, so the template has to rebuild it -- see docs/conventions.md
Track versions annotated with a `# renovate:` comment. Needed for image tags written inline in a Helm `valuesObject:`, which the helm-values manager only reads from real values files.
